title: A lead changed elsewhere moves the work order to its new group on refresh
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin user (Work orders > View and Create & Edit) at {Location-A}, in a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Technicians "Esther Howard" and "Aaron Baker" are active at {Location-A} (the expected results name them, so use these two).
  • Customer {Customer-A}, used by this case only, has five Approved work orders: {Work-order-1}, {Work-order-2} and {Work-order-3} led by Esther Howard, and {Work-order-4} and {Work-order-5} led by Aaron Baker.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST F2 Refresh Lead and {Work-order-1} is S2-35331 (the expected results call it "S1-702").
  • Two tabs of the same browser window are open, tab A and tab B, both signed in as you.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. In tab A, click "Work Orders" in the top menu.
  2. In tab A, click the "All" tab.
  3. In tab A, type the name of {Customer-A} in "Search".
  4. In tab A, click "Tech View" in the display switcher.
  5. In tab B, open {Work-order-1} and change "Lead Technician" to Aaron Baker (it saves at once).
  6. Go back to tab A without refreshing and look at {Work-order-1}.
  7. Refresh tab A.
  8. Look at {Work-order-1} and the two group counts.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Before the refresh, tab A may still show S1-702 under Esther Howard.
  • After the refresh, S1-702 is under Aaron Baker. Esther Howard shows 2 (3 - 1) and Aaron Baker shows 3 (2 + 1).

QA lead decision, 19 Oct 2026: the second technician is Aaron Baker instead of Ralph Edwards, because Ralph Edwards cannot be picked on the work order page.

Source — where this behaviour comes from

Epic SV-10043; story SV-10045 (Story 2, Tech View — table grouped by lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S2-E2, read 8 Oct 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-E2: “After a lead change elsewhere, move the work order to its new technician group on the next refresh.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.
